name: Bujag-jong = Namchin!?
source:
After 19 years of wearing an XL, suddenly I became an S!?

I participated in a mysterious experiment for weight loss that worked overnight but... Nobody told me that the side effects would make me get a boyfriend!
translation:
穿了19年的XL，突然变成了S！？

我参加了一个神秘的减肥实验，一夜之间就见效了，但是……没有人告诉我副作用会让我交男朋友！
